import re
p='/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature/crates/elephc-builtin-contract/src/catalog_data.rs'
s=open(p).read()
names=['fopen','fgetcsv','fputcsv','str_getcsv','fscanf','fpassthru','ftruncate','fstat','fflush','fsync','fdatasync','stream_get_contents','file_get_contents','copy','tmpfile','tempnam','rewinddir','readdir','opendir','closedir','pclose','popen','umask','fread','fwrite','fgets','fgetc']
# split entries by 'id: BuiltinId::from_canonical_name('
parts=s.split('id: BuiltinId::from_canonical_name(')
for part in parts[1:]:
    m=re.match(r'\"([^\"]+)\"\)', part)
    if not m: continue
    n=m.group(1)
    if n not in names: continue
    # capture up to the next 'php_manual' or 600 chars
    idx=part.find('php_manual')
    chunk=part[:idx+80] if idx>0 else part[:600]
    # compress whitespace
    chunk=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',chunk)
    print('###',n)
    print(chunk[:1400])
    print()
